title: Glowing pencil
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='glow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffee88'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffbb33'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='body' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd94d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffaa22'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- outer glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='42' ry='42' fill='#ffdd66' opacity='0.18'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='34' ry='34' fill='#ffdd66' opacity='0.22'/>
  <!-- pencil body rotated -->
  <g transform='rotate(45 50 50)'>
    <!-- eraser -->
    <rect x='42' y='12' width='16' height='10' rx='4' fill='#ff88bb'/>
    <rect x='42' y='12' width='16' height='4' rx='4' fill='#ffb3d1'/>
    <!-- ferrule -->
    <rect x='42' y='22' width='16' height='6' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
    <rect x='42' y='22' width='16' height='2' fill='#fff4cc'/>
    <!-- wood body -->
    <rect x='42' y='28' width='16' height='34' fill='url(#body)'/>
    <!-- wood facet highlight -->
    <rect x='42' y='28' width='5' height='34' fill='#fff0b0' opacity='0.7'/>
    <!-- sharpened wood cone -->
    <polygon points='42,62 58,62 50,80' fill='#ffcc55'/>
    <polygon points='42,62 50,80 44,62' fill='#ffe9a0' opacity='0.8'/>
    <!-- graphite tip glowing -->
    <polygon points='47,74 53,74 50,82' fill='#fffbe0'/>
    <polygon points='48.5,76 51.5,76 50,81' fill='#ffffff'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='30' r='2.2' fill='#fff6c0' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='64' r='1.8' fill='#fff6c0' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='26' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='72' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M50 18 l1.4 3.4 3.4 1.4 -3.4 1.4 -1.4 3.4 -1.4 -3.4 -3.4 -1.4 3.4 -1.4z' fill='#fffbe0' opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d='M78 50 l1 2.4 2.4 1 -2.4 1 -1 2.4 -1 -2.4 -2.4 -1 2.4 -1z' fill='#fffbe0' opacity='0.9'/>
</svg>
